integrity: Symbolic argument and independent finite examples provided; earlier Fourier parameterizations and idempotent counts are prior work; historical priority has not been independently established.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian groups of odd order, complex coefficients, subset ideals of the idempotent magma only; no assertion about linear ideals, modular fields or nonabelian quandles.
title: The Boolean ideal lattice and maximal quandle strata of complex core-quandle idempotents
